updates.title: Encrypted Notes
updates.body: Write, format, and organize private notes - encrypted at rest inside your vault. Rich text with bold, italic, colors, and highlights. Premium unlocks unlimited notes with the full toolbar.

updates.title: Slideshow Viewer
updates.body: Turn any folder of images into a hands-free slideshow. Auto-advance, swipe controls, full-screen. Premium adds shuffle, custom intervals, and transitions.

updates.title: About the Dev
updates.body: A new section to stay in the loop - see what’s shipping, what’s next, and support development directly with optional one-time contributions.

updates.title: Stealth PIN Recovery
updates.body: Forgot your Calculator Stealth PIN? Tap AC seven times to trigger biometric verification and reset it. No settings menu, no obvious flow - just a quiet escape hatch.

updates.title: German & Vietnamese
updates.body: Lockify now speaks German and Vietnamese. The entire app - menus, settings, prompts, and vault UI - is fully translated. More languages on the way.
